subject: READY_FOR_PRIMARY: setup/readiness truth design; physical runtime claims remain gated
body: RECOVERED after source-verification/artifact construction crossed the current 60s paired-write ceiling. Manager independently verifies Research ZIP 9fe83214... and all internal SHA entries; setup truth model reruns 9/9 PASS. Exact-current SOURCE confirms: ShizukuBridge.refresh can publish human-readable State.Ready while service is still null/binding even though ShizukuBridge.ready requires service!=null; PersistentRuntimeService unconditionally says 'Duo Open is ready'; SetupGuide's 'has no network access' is false because INTERNET is requested and DebugBundleUploader has configured HTTPS POST transport; current source does implement Open Shizuku package launch + web fallback. Disposition READY_FOR_PRIMARY for a single aggregate setup/readiness state model, accurate notification/copy and clearer Duo-wallpaper vs Samsung-FoldInteractive guidance. NEEDS_PHYSICAL_EVIDENCE remains for launcher runtime behavior, binder death/rebind, wallpaper picker/panel assignment and actual Fold7 angle/cover behavior. Android CI NOT_EVIDENCED.
